title: Galvanized neighborhood after a local lead ban
source: EPA 815-F-25-005 (Aug 2026) p.5, Example 2: galvanized lines installed after a local lead ban, with tap cards, are Non-lead, not GRR. https://www.epa.gov/system/files/documents/2026-08/508_0813inventorytips_clean.pdf

docs.title: Town plumbing code
docs.text: Adopted 1965: lead pipe prohibited for water services. Copper or galvanized only.

docs.title: Tap card
docs.text: Service installed 8/15/72. 3/4 galvanized, main to curb stop.

docs.title: Plumbing permit
docs.text: New home. Meter to house 3/4 galvanized.

title: Lead utility side replaced, galvanized customer side
source: EPA 816-B-22-001 (Aug 2022) p.2-2, Exhibit 2-1: galvanized customer side downstream of a utility side that was lead and has been replaced is GRR. https://www.epa.gov/system/files/documents/2022-08/Inventory%20Guidance_Final%20080322_1.pdf

docs.title: Tap card
docs.text: Lead service 3/4, main to curb box. Set 1934.

docs.title: Work order
docs.text: Replaced utility-owned lead service main to curb box with 1 in. copper.

docs.title: Basement inspection
docs.text: Customer side from meter into house is galvanized.

title: Lead utility side, copper customer side
source: 40 CFR 141.84(d)(6)(iii)(A) table 2; EPA 816-B-22-001 p.2-5, Exhibit 2-3: system Lead + customer Non-lead = Lead.

docs.title: Curb stop excavation
docs.text: Utility side at curb stop: lead, soft gray, scratches silver.

docs.title: Plumbing permit
docs.text: Customer water service meter to house replaced with 1 in. copper.

title: Unknown utility side, galvanized customer side
source: 40 CFR 141.84(d)(6)(iii)(A) table 2; EPA 816-B-22-001 p.2-5, Exhibit 2-3: system Unknown + customer GRR = GRR.

docs.title: Inventory record
docs.text: Utility side: no tap card, material unknown.

docs.title: Basement inspection
docs.text: Customer side pipe at entry is galvanized.

title: Unknown utility side, copper customer side
source: 40 CFR 141.84(d)(6)(iii)(A) table 2; EPA 816-B-22-001 p.2-5, Exhibit 2-3: system Unknown + customer Non-lead = Lead Status Unknown.

docs.title: Inventory record
docs.text: Utility side: material not documented.

docs.title: Plumbing permit
docs.text: Meter to house 3/4 copper.

title: Lead gooseneck, galvanized both sides
source: Vermont DEC LSLI FAQ #1 (2024-06-28) p.1; Washington DOH 331-804 (2026-07) p.2: galvanized downstream of only a lead connector is not GRR. https://doh.wa.gov/sites/default/files/2026-07/331-804.pdf

docs.title: Tap card
docs.text: Service installed 6/3/48. Lead gooseneck at main. 3/4 galvanized main to curb stop.

docs.title: Plumbing permit
docs.text: Meter to house 3/4 galvanized.

title: Lead pigtail, rest copper
source: Nevada DEP LSLI FAQ #12 (2023-05-12) p.8: a lead pigtail with no other lead or galvanized pipe is Non-lead with the pigtail noted.

docs.title: Excavation at main
docs.text: Lead pigtail at the corporation stop, about 18 in. Then copper to curb stop.

docs.title: Plumbing permit
docs.text: Meter to house 3/4 copper.

title: Pipe in wall, installed after Vermont ban
source: Vermont DEC LSLI FAQ #12 (2024-06-28) p.2: line not visible but records show installation after the state lead ban (1989-07-01) is Non-lead.

docs.title: Service installation record
docs.text: New service installed 5/18/1993, main to house. Material not written on card.

docs.title: Inspection
docs.text: Service enters through finished wall; pipe not visible.

title: Installed after California's 1986 cutoff
source: California State Water Board LSLI FAQ (2025-07) p.8, p.10: service lines with records showing installation after January 1, 1986 are Non-lead. https://waterboards.ca.gov/lead-copper-rule/docs/lcrr-lsli-faq.pdf

docs.title: Subdivision service log
docs.text: Lot 14: water service installed 8/14/1986, main to house, inspected.

title: No records; copper at curb, galvanized inside
source: Virginia VDH LSL inventory guidance slides (2022-10-13) p.10, restating EPA 816-B-22-001: copper found on an unknown utility side may be a replacement, so the galvanized customer side is GRR.

docs.title: Curb stop excavation
docs.text: No records on file. Utility side at curb stop is copper.

docs.title: Basement inspection
docs.text: Customer side at entry is galvanized.

title: Lead-lined galvanized
source: 40 CFR 141.2 'lead service line': a lead-lined galvanized service line is a lead service line; Maine DWP FAQ #35 p.5.

docs.title: Tap card
docs.text: 3/4 lead-lined galvanized, main to curb.

docs.title: Plumbing permit
docs.text: Meter to house 3/4 copper.

title: Only an operator's statement, not approved
source: EPA 815-F-25-005 (Aug 2026) p.2, Example 1: an operator statement can classify lines only once the primacy agency approves it; without approval they stay Unknown.

docs.title: Operator statement
docs.text: In my 24 years with the district I have never seen a lead service. All the ones I dug up were copper or plastic.

docs.text: No material records for this service.
